summary.text: Zeno Parry is the Utah Forward Party candidate for the Utah House of Representatives, District 70, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Republican Carl R. Albrecht and Democrat Stacey Pendergraft.

paragraphs.text: Parry has run for the Utah House several times before.
He ran as a Democrat in District 72 in 2018, losing to Rex Shipp.
Parry then ran in District 70 as a United Utah Party candidate, receiving 8.1 percent of the vote against Albrecht in 2022 and 6.7 percent in 2024.
